items.name: Dice
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: fantasy equipment inventory illustration, isolated square transparent cutout.
Primary request: Create an original detailed Dice item illustration.
Subject: A well-crafted dark brown leather dice cup tipped onto its side with a small collection of warm brass polyhedral dice spilling out. Ornate understated metal trim on cup, engraved numerals on dice. Keep the same subject, material palette and identity as reference Image 1, create a much clearer richly detailed larger illustration.
Reference images: style references for hand-painted medieval fantasy inventory items, aged leather and metal, fine tactile texture, restrained earthy palette, softly directional studio-like lighting, softly painted realistic object rendering and crisp silhouette. For Dice, Image 1 also specifies the existing item identity. Do not copy unrelated reference objects into this image.
Composition: the complete requested item centered at generous readable scale, contained within a square canvas with safe margins. Match existing equipment inventory art rather than a scene. No people, no character, no environment, no ground plane, no floor, no rectangular background, no floating shadow panel. Genuine transparent background with clean alpha around every edge; contained lighting and any magical effect.
Constraints: no text or title, no logo, no watermark, no frame. Small dice numerals are appropriate; not a text label. No modern objects.
